audio_sources.title: 魔法が存在する世界で

points.action_zh: 饭碗递出后切近景，不重递
points.action_en: Match-cut to the offered bowl
points.music_intent: 轻落点：乐句轻收，不加打击音

points.action_en: Cut to the bowl being knocked away
points.music_intent: 转折重音候选；随后给火祭消息留出空间

points.action_zh: GPT画外允许入内，守卫开始让路
points.action_en: GPT permits entry; guards begin clearing the way
points.music_intent: 弱起进入，不用重击抢对白

points.action_en: Cut to GPT refusing
points.music_intent: 乐句收窄，避让对白；不把拒绝做成暴怒重击

points.action_zh: 右手放下后开始轻搓双手
points.action_en: Begin the gentle hand rub after lowering the right hand
points.music_intent: 低动态延续；这一点是表演节奏，不强加重拍

points.action_zh: 切到肩后，双手分开后准备起身
points.action_en: Cut behind the shoulder; separate hands to begin rising
points.music_intent: 情绪开始转向；音乐不在切批处重启

points.action_zh: 进入鲸帽卡住石沿的镜头
points.action_en: Cut to the hat catching the stone edge
points.music_intent: 用轻悬念脉冲；接触声前景

points.action_en: Begin checking the lock and chain
points.music_intent: 弱拍延续，金属声清晰

points.action_zh: 手停在锁扣上，脚步先到
points.action_en: Hand stops at the lock as footsteps arrive
points.music_intent: 压低配乐，给画外脚步留白

points.action_zh: 进入被推开后仍想阻止的镜头
points.action_en: Cut to the push and continued resistance
points.music_intent: 第一次压力重音；跌倒接触音独立处理

points.action_en: Cut to the torch handover
points.music_intent: 持续加压，别盖过教主台词

points.action_en: Claude begins her protective shout
points.music_intent: 压乐让台词突出

points.action_en: Cut to the child losing balance and falling
points.music_intent: 落地段重音候选；保留真实落地声

points.action_en: Begin the kindling ignition shot
points.music_intent: 燃起段开始推升，随火势发展

points.action_en: Begin the pre-breach stillness
points.music_intent: 暂时抽掉音乐，保留空间张力

points.action_en: Cut into the door breach
points.music_intent: 破门段强落点；真实撞击时刻待动态验收

points.action_zh: 教主回身，Kimi画外咏唱将起
points.action_en: Cut to the leader turning; Kimi chant follows
points.music_intent: 切换Kimi专曲；声线跨批延续

points.action_zh: 月光开始流入，尚无人形
points.action_en: Moonlight starts flowing in before any silhouette
points.music_intent: 沿用上批专曲原位置，不从头重播

points.action_zh: 完成四秒显形，切近景举刃
points.action_en: After four seconds of formation, cut closer to the blade
points.music_intent: 柔和乐句落点；避让随后咏唱

points.action_en: Begin the blade-linked arrival shot
points.music_intent: 爆发落点候选

points.action_zh: 进入暗月闭合与挡法术镜头
points.action_en: Begin the dark-moon closure shot
points.music_intent: 第二次展开，接续同一乐句

points.action_zh: 骑士入场，恢复主救援配乐
points.action_en: Knights enter; cut out of the dome interior
points.music_intent: 从Kimi专曲转回救援主题，需乐句剪接

points.action_zh: 切到月背两路救援的约定
points.action_en: Cut to the two-route rescue agreement
points.music_intent: 降低动态，完整听清分工

points.action_en: Begin the wing-spread and lift-off shot
points.music_intent: 开始推升；10.2秒咏唱进入后让出频段

points.action_en: Cut to Qwen opening the fan
points.music_intent: 器械声落点；咏唱连续，不另开一拍

points.action_en: Begin the midair interception shot
points.music_intent: 短促动作重音候选

points.action_en: Cut to the water dragon diving
points.music_intent: 乐句推进，不提前播放破顶撞击重音

points.action_en: Water dragon breaches the roof past the camera
points.music_intent: 强落点目标，衔接前批俯冲

points.action_en: Pause the incantation during the seal shot
points.music_intent: 5–5.8秒收声留白，保留水流

points.action_en: Release the seal and begin pointing
points.music_intent: 攻击启动落点

points.action_en: Cut to the low-angle shield collision shot
points.music_intent: 撞击高潮段；不可把切镜当成已完成碰撞

points.action_en: Cut to the shallow-water aftermath
points.music_intent: 重音后退潮，拉开动态

points.action_en: GPT delivers the curt reply
points.music_intent: 压乐让短句突出

points.action_en: Begin the white-violet dragon transformation
points.music_intent: 变身新起势，不覆盖前一句

points.action_zh: 进入省略激战的天空镜头
points.action_en: Begin the sky battle ellipsis
points.music_intent: 保留远处冲击；不逐次闪光机械卡拍

points.action_en: Cut to rain falling inside
points.music_intent: 音乐回落，雨滴前景

points.action_en: Cut to GPT looking down after the victory
points.music_intent: 收束战斗乐句，为钥匙声留空间

points.action_en: Begin unlocking the ankle chain
points.music_intent: 低动态或留白，锁扣声成为落点

points.action_en: Claude begins the faint-light incantation
points.music_intent: 柔和抬起

points.action_en: Cut to the impending interruption by her father
points.music_intent: 压乐或停乐，让7.3秒呼唤进入

points.action_en: Claude chooses to continue the incantation
points.music_intent: 从上一批留白后重新抬起；不当新歌开头

points.action_zh: 切到火种触木燃起镜头
points.action_en: Cut to the spark igniting the wood
points.music_intent: 动作重音候选

points.action_en: Claude weakens after withdrawing her hand
points.music_intent: 音乐回落，接抱动作和呼吸前景

points.action_en: Cut to the market days later
points.music_intent: 切入结尾主题，完成场景转换

points.action_zh: 切到这次接住勺子的手
points.action_en: Cut to the hand accepting the spoon
points.music_intent: 轻落点回应片头，避免夸张撞击声

points.action_zh: 结束配乐，只留街市和呼吸
points.action_en: Music ends in post; keep market ambience and breathing
points.music_intent: 最后四秒明确无BGM；此前淡出区间待混音

important_windows.meaning: 破门前BGM静默；无词教徒吟唱/空间声按镜头设计保留，不等于全音轨静音。
水龙破顶目标，实际碰撞帧尚待动态结果。
祈愿与术名之间留0.8秒；BGM避免填满，水流保持。
解印前指启动；不要将攻击高潮提前到术名。
撞盾镜开头，不冒称已确定真实撞击帧。
父亲打断与Claude反应共6秒，应压乐或停乐；372.5续咏后才恢复情绪。
最后4秒明确无BGM，只保留街市与呼吸。

issues.finding: 全部46动作目标的source_seconds为空，7首曲的source_in/source_out为空；尚无当前435.5秒版本的原曲乐句剪辑与对齐。
issues.required_action: 保持action_targets_music_alignment_pending；选定每段原曲in/out、乐句剪接与必要静音后逐点听审，不能以时间数字存在当成卡点完成。

issues.required_action: 以现有曲目做有意识的乐句重编和留白，避免自动循环/拉伸。优先把召集回闪、解锁、父亲打断和离殿等对白段落纳入留白方案；听审后确定。
issues.auto_fix: 不能仅填0秒起播；不能自动更换采用曲。

issues.scope: 当前预演台与后期/静帧配乐-v002
issues.required_action: 当前音画卡点验收需新的同步试听/剪辑时间线；旧试听保留历史标签，不作为当前7首配乐验收证据。
issues.auto_fix: 可加清晰的未锁定说明，不必重建旧版。

issues.finding: 跨曲入口28、67、108、162、175、205.5、411.5秒目前仅有画面区间与音乐意图，没有具体淡变/剪接长度；对白避让也仍是文字设计。
issues.required_action: 以最终日语实测句长安排压乐、停乐、恢复和乐句呼吸，尤其366.5–372.5秒父亲打断及431.5–435.5秒末尾静音；不要按15秒批次重新起乐。
issues.auto_fix: 静音边界可从当前画面记录，淡变长度与音量需实际混音听审。
